items.headline: Sources: Michigan QB Bryce Underwood expected to start vs. rival Ohio State
items.description: Michigan QB Bryce Underwood, who had been dealing with a hamstring injury, is now expected to start Saturday against Ohio State, sources told ESPN's Pete Thamel.

items.headline: Sources: Manuel to remain Michigan AD until new hire is found
items.description: Warde Manuel has agreed to stay in the job as Michigan's athletic director until the school finds a new athletic director, sources told ESPN on Wednesday.
